title: UI风格#241 - Retro Terminal (复古终端)
description: 创建第241种UI风格：复古终端风格 - CRT屏幕、绿色字符、命令行怀旧。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planII.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When color palette Then features phosphor green, amber, CRT black
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#00FF00 (磷绿), #FFB000 (琥珀), #0D0D0D (CRT黑), #003300 (深绿)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When typography Then uses monospace: VT323, Fira Code, IBM Plex Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：VT323 (复古), Fira Code (现代), IBM Plex Mono (经典)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When layout Then command prompt, terminal window, scanlines
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：命令提示符、终端窗口、扫描线

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When UI elements Then CRT glow, flicker effect, cursor blink
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：CRT发光、闪烁效果、光标闪烁

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal UI When functional Then includes bash chat, terminal agents, boot stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：终端聊天、系统代理、启动统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal UI When copy Then uses terminal: 'Boot', 'Execute', 'Terminal', 'Bash'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'BOOT. EXECUTE. TERMINAL.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'EXEC'、'DEPLOY'→'BOOT'
